boxesUsed: saved Windows dets[:,2:6] cast to float32 (the detector output dtype in extract.consume); order, frames, scores unchanged
emb_idxCheck: saved emb_idx equals the extract.consume rule (even frame, h>=36, score>=0.25) for these boxes
cropSetCheck: the 1333 OCR crop files of the decode-swap run equal the extract.consume crop rule (even frame, h>=80, score>=0.4) for the Windows boxes

decodedFrames.windowsPath: FFmpeg 6.1.1 CLI, scale=in_color_matrix=bt601:in_range=tv, bgr24: 300/300 hashes equal the Windows probe (which equals the original Windows run 301/301)
decodedFrames.linuxPath: cv2.VideoCapture (OpenCV 4.14.0 pip wheel), seek CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES 11500: 300/300 hashes equal the Linux probe/run

sigsResidual.explanation: the float32 value lies 3e-8 (about one float32 ulp) above the midpoint between two float16 values; a one-ulp float32 difference between the Windows and Linux numpy/OpenCV builds flips the float16 rounding. One element, one float16 ulp (2.4e-4). Tolerance: exact equality except elements within one float32 ulp of a float16 rounding midpoint; no other element differs.

unchangedFields: OCR crop files (Windows-pixel crops from the decode-swap run)
hiddenDependencies: tracker association (tracklets.track_rows -> PlayerTracker.update) uses sigs as appearance features, so a colour swap is also an association swap
tracklets.purify (track-wide colour purification) uses sigs and can relabel rows before the swapped frames
kit scores (contacts, team filter, identity) derive from sigs
crossings contact-link costs use sigs and embs (EMB_WEIGHT 0.3)

OCR crop SELECTION depends on tracklet structure: a colour swap made the pipeline ask for 25 crops the Windows run never read; they were read on Windows pixels (read) or answered with no text (blank) - both gave identical outcomes
grass, warps/cuts (camera motion), ball_warm and OCR crop pixels stay Windows-decoded in every variant
